TARUN GELLI       tarunrpa.uipath@gmail.com  (+91)- 9491355515   

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 

Having total 4.2 years in RPA UiPath the RPA field majorly worked on Web-based, Desktop, Outlook and Excel automations.

Involved in different phases of process. Design, Development, Testing, Integration, Implementation and Maintenance.

Certified on UiPath Foundation Course – Diploma, UiPath Advanced Automation Course – Diploma,

UiPath RPA Developer Advanced and Orchestrator, UiPath Agentic Automation Associate

Having good exposure to UiPath Studio, Orchestrator, and RE Framework design.

Experience of UiPath Document Understanding, Action Center, AI Center, and GEN AI Capabilities.

Knowledge of SAP, Mainframe, CV Automation, WEB API Integration, Data base connection, Test suite.

Experienced in automation of Work Queues, Exception Handling, Assets, Object repository, and Storage Buckets by using UiPath.

Involved in creating PDD’s and SDD’s for the processes.

Created Re-usable components for automating several application Login pages and knowledge on Version control system integrations like GIT HUB.

Have end-to-end orchestrator experience on like Managing Robots, Jobs, Logs, Queues, Triggers, Assets, and Machines etc.

Proficient in deployment and debugging applications in all environments and maintaining environment up to time.

Knowledge of UiPath Active Learning, Autopilot, UiPath Agentic automation.

Automated Web, Citrix, Webservices (REST API’s), OLEDB database, SQL database, Windows based applications and multiple excel operations using UiPath tool.

Experience in UiPath Orchestrator, Work Queues, Exception handling, Calanders, Schedules, and Session management using UiPath tool.

Having a good understanding of Multi-Bot Architecture.

WORK EXPERIENCE 

            Company Name: - Capgemini, Hyderabad                                  Duration: Since Jan 2022 to present 

                  Designation: Consultant

                  Client: -Tetrapak, NatWest, Unilever, Fortive

AUTOMATION PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT 

Completing APRO Statements in Oracle (Web, Excel, Outlook, Oracle Data base - Applications)

ECM PO Load (PDF, Excel, Outlook, Word - Applications)

AP PO and non-PO process (Outlook, Excel, Oracle web, Document understanding, Action Centre, AI Centre - Applications).

Create Remittance Process (MS Excel, Shared drive, and Agresso web - Applications)

POS & Inventory Process (Macro, Excel, share point, Share drive, Oracle Data base, Outlook -

Applications)  

EAMS TO FUZE (WEB, MS Excel - Applications)

AMS Reactive Costing: (SAP, WEB API’S, MS Excel, Outlook -

Applications) 

         ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITES 

Involved in development based on client requirements by following design and operational documents.

Created PDD’s and SDD’s documents for automation.

Development and technical assistance on UiPath.

Do feasibility study for automation with UiPath.

Involved in defect fixing that was assigned by QA/ UAT team.

Prepared the documentation for UAT Test cases and Runbook.

Involved and provided Support/ Hyper care for production processes.

Designed solutions utilizing RPA best practices and maintaining technical responsibility for project delivery.

Analysed the feasibility of existing process suitable for automation.

Involved in managing BOT's workloads using Orchestrator Work Queues.

Creating ODI (Object Design Instruction) and developing respective PDI (Process Design Instruction) when required for automation process.

Efficiently handled monitoring and troubleshooting the UiPath environment through Orchestrator.

CERTIFICATIONS & LEARNINGS 

UiPath Certifications: RPA Developer Advanced, Document Understanding, Action Center, AI Center, Agentic Associate Diploma and Orchestrator, AAAv1 UiPath Agentic Automation Associate

TECHNICAL SKILLS  

Desktop Operating Systems   : Windows 7/8/10, Linux Primary Skill 	: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) using UiPath Programming Languages 	: VB.Net and ADO.Net Database 	: MS SQL Server, My SQL, Oracle & MS Access Bug Tracking Tool / Tools 	: ServiceNow, Jira tools

AWARDS AND RECOGNIGATION 

Ace of Invent

Innovation & Ideas

XTRA Mile

Outstanding Contribution in Delivery

  PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATION 

Bachelor of Commerce, Indira Gandhi National University, New Delhi

PERSONAL DETAILS 

	                       Name                        : Tarun Gelli

                       Gender 	: Male 

	                  Marital status         : Married 

DECLARATION 

I hereby declare that all above-mentioned information is in accordance with fact or truth up to my knowledge and I bear the responsibilities for the correctness of the above-mentioned particulars. 

Date: 

	Place: Hyderabad 	Tarun Gelli
